carryover_and_nontriggers: The cannot_suspend restriction on entity-9 expires only at actual Aturn7 end and survives ordinary evolution; it does not prohibit evolution or attempted unsuspend processing.
Ordinary evolution changes no orientation and is not a Tamer play. No suspension, unsuspension, Tamer-play observer, Rina AllTurns activation or inherited Aero unsuspend fires just from evolution.

After evolution, EX13-022 main-text Tamer-play restriction is not active under Ulforce. It cannot retroactively observe the later Rina play. Its inherited self-suspension effect is active but sees no suspension.

BT11-032 own blue-Tamer-play self-unsuspend has no printed OPT. Resolve it mandatorily, even already unsuspended. Its separate bounce OPT does not trigger or consume a use without a genuine suspended->unsuspended change.
Neither existing nor newly played BT11Rina memory OPT is consumed by processing an already-unsuspended Digimon. EX13Rina has no printed OPT.

A current-turn restriction also remains on BT12-029 through actual Aturn7 end; BBlocker/Evade remains on BEX13#3 through that same boundary. A new Rina grant would instead remain through actual Bturn8 end.

official_rules_excerpts.text: If a card in a given state is requested to be changed to that same state, the card remains in its current state.
Even if a card on the field becomes the bottom card in a stack due to cards being placed on top of it, it isn't considered to be a new card.
A digivolved Digimon carries over its orientation from before the digivolution.
The player places the Digimon for the digivolution on top of the chosen card, draws 1 card, and the digivolution process is resolved.
When an effect is gained, the effect and the state of the effect at that time will be carried over, even if a card is placed on top of that card or a card is removed from its stack.
The Digimon is already unsuspended, so this card’s inherited effect doesn’t activate. The Digimon must go from suspended to unsuspended for the effect to activate.
